post_publication_highlights.title: Complete Moreau chance-constrained consistency theorem
post_publication_highlights.contribution_type: Formalization of established mathematics, with conditional norm convergence
post_publication_highlights.claim: The complete original MoreauChance.Consistency.theorem_5_4: finiteness and convergence of optimal values, optimality of weak limits of regularized optimizers, and norm convergence under the original additional objective-finiteness and conjugate-differentiability hypotheses.
post_publication_highlights.why_it_matters: Connects regularized chance-constrained optimization to the original problem and completes the strong-convergence clause using approximate envelope minimizers, without adding exact proximal attainment or finite dimensionality.
assumptions: Real separable complete Hilbert decision space, complete normed constraint space, probability law with the source absolute-continuity hypothesis.
The exact source conic-setting and continuity assumptions, proper lower-semicontinuous convex coercive extended-real objective, and a feasible point with finite objective.
For the sequence conclusions: positive parameters tending to zero, optimal regularized solutions and an assumed weak limit.

For norm convergence additionally: the objective is finite everywhere and its conjugate is Frechet differentiable at every point with nonempty subdifferential. All original quantified assumptions are retained.

verification.kind: Lean kernel verification and Prove2Me acceptance; separate AI review
verification.control_scope: Three false scalar assertions reject; positive quadratic consumer and obstruction lemmas exercise the convergence mechanism. These are not full counterexamples to weakened chance-constrained roots.

original_mathematics.title: Inner Moreau envelope of nonsmooth conic chance constrained optimization problems
